message: No detected input validation: The code loads numpy arrays and tensors directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape validations, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Model weights are downloaded from hardcoded pytorch.org URLs via torch.utils.model_zoo with no checksum verification, pinned commit, or authenticated source handling.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples before they are used.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are downloaded directly from public URLs in model_urls dict (e.g., 'https://download.pytorch.org/models/resnet50-19c8e357.pth') via model_zoo without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision control.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads class weights and filters low-count labels but performs no explicit class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied; the optimizer is plain SGD or Adam without any noise-addition mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack routines anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (F1, loss, accuracy) are tracked, there is no evidence of a cryptographically isolated held-out test set, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other controls explicitly preventing metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code processes inputs directly via get_tensor_from_data() without any shape, range, or schema validation before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks are applied to model outputs before they are returned or stored.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision (ResNet-based image classification) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
